```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
load("../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/Burden_Prop_Plot.RData")
load("../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/R2_Barplot_Burden.RData")
load("../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/cor_box.RData")
load("../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/cor_bar.RData")
# Panel E (added 2026-11-04, Reviewer 4 comment 5): within-cohort sociodemographic
# contribution for individual chemicals, every cohort -- written by
# Within_Study_SDOH_Compare.Rmd but previously not in any figure.
load("../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/R2_Barplot_ByStudy.RData")

```

```{r}



pdf(file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/Final_Patchplots/FigureS14_All.pdf",height = 24, width = 18)
# The overall title "Aggregate Exposure Score" was dropped when panel E (individual
# chemicals, not the aggregate score) was added; panels D and E carry
# descriptive titles so the two by-cohort panels cannot be confused.
panel_e <- r2_barplot_bystudy +
  labs(title = "Sociodemographic contribution by cohort, individual chemicals",
       x = expression("Contribution to prediction (mean " * R^2 * ")"))
patch <- ( cor_box | cor_bar ) /
  (burden_prop | r2_barplot_agg + ggtitle("Sociodemographic contribution by cohort, cumulative score") +
     labs(x = expression("Contribution to prediction (mean " * R^2 * ")"))) /
  panel_e
patch + 
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1.1)) +
  #plot_layout(guides = "collect") +    
  plot_annotation(
  tag_levels = "A"
)  &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 20),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 15)) 
dev.off()
```
